messages.subject: Maple Court - regulatory strategy advice note [PRIVILEGED]
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Lorna, Iqbal,

Please find attached our advice note on regulatory strategy following the Warning Notice and the draft 'Inadequate' report. In short:

- The core medicines failing is, regrettably, made out on the records and not realistically contestable.
- Our strongest position is to correct specific factual errors via factual accuracy comments, evidence prompt remediation, and resist disproportionate conditions (especially any restriction on admissions).
- The Warning Notice carries no appeal; the key is to show the breach is remedied by 30 April.
- A Notice of Proposal on conditions is likely; a Notice of Decision after representations does carry a First-tier Tribunal appeal route, which we'll preserve.

This is privileged - please keep circulation to the senior team.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
